item.title: The Bible’s Go-To Language for What We Call a “Christian”
item.description: The Bible’s go-to language for what we call “Christian” is being “in Christ.” John uses that language three dozen times. Paul uses the language of being “in him,” “in Jesus,” or him being “in us.”
